title: Automotive Aerodynamics, Direct-Shift Gearboxes (DSG) & Internal Combustion Optimization
description: Advanced powertrain and chassis engineering module examining aerodynamic drag coefficients (Cd), dual-clutch transmission electro-hydraulics, and variable valve timing.
learning_objectives: Master advanced powertrain terminology (dual-mass flywheel, mechatronics valve body, variable valve timing VVT, Atkinson cycle, ground-effect diffuser)
Apply inverted conditionals and complex passive reporting in automotive mechanical failure analysis
Demonstrate fluency when drafting dynamometer reports and aerodynamic test evaluations

questions.prompt: _____ automotive aerodynamicists not designed an active underbody venturi tunnel, high-speed aerodynamic downforce would have collapsed.

explanations.correct: Inverted Third Conditional 'Had aerodynamicists not designed...' correctly expresses a past counterfactual premise without 'if'.
explanations.wrong_A: 'If' requires the auxiliary 'had' after the subject.
explanations.wrong_C: 'Were' forms a Second Conditional, incompatible with past 'would have collapsed'.

questions.cz_learning_point: Inverze 3. kondicionálu v automobilovém vývoji: 'Had aerodynamicists not designed...' = 'Kdyby aerodynamici nenavrhli...'. Do podmínky nepatří 'if'.

questions.prompt: Rarely _____ a dual-mass flywheel suffer torsional spring failure unless the engine operates with persistent cylinder misfiring.

explanations.correct: Negative adverb 'Rarely' triggers subject-auxiliary inversion with Present Simple auxiliary 'does': 'Rarely does a dual-mass flywheel suffer...'.
explanations.wrong_B: 'is' cannot serve as auxiliary for base verb 'suffer'.
explanations.wrong_C: 'will' changes the sentence to predictive future rather than engineering fact.

questions.cz_learning_point: Záporné příslovce 'Rarely' na začátku věty vyžaduje inverzi pomocného slovesa 'does' a podmětu: 'Rarely does a flywheel suffer...'.

questions.prompt: If the calibration engineer had mapped the variable valve timing (VVT) solenoid correctly last week, the engine _____ rough idle oscillations today.

explanations.correct: Mixed conditional: past cause ('had mapped') with present ongoing result ('today') takes 'would not be exhibiting'.
explanations.wrong_B: 'would not have exhibited' refers purely to past result, but adverbial 'today' anchors consequence to the present.
explanations.wrong_C: 'will not exhibit' is First Conditional, incompatible with past counterfactual condition.
explanations.wrong_D: Simple present indicative 'does not exhibit' cannot express hypothetical consequence.

questions.cz_learning_point: Smíšený kondicionál: minulá příčina spojená s přítomným následkem: 'If he had mapped [minulost], it would not be exhibiting [dnes]'.

questions.prompt: Automotive emissions homologation regulations mandate that every direct-injection engine _____ strict particulate filter regeneration limits.

explanations.correct: Mandative subjunctive after 'mandate that' requires base form 'satisfy' regardless of 3rd person singular subject.
explanations.wrong_A: Indicative 'satisfies' with 3rd person -s violates mandative subjunctive syntax.
explanations.wrong_B: Future 'will satisfy' is incorrect after mandative 'mandate that'.

questions.cz_learning_point: Subjunktiv po slovesech předpisů (mandate that every engine satisfy): sloveso zůstává v základním tvaru bez -s.

questions.prompt: _____ the dynamic cylinder pressure curves on the test dyno, powertrain specialists adjusted spark timing to prevent pre-ignition.

explanations.correct: Perfect active participle 'Having analyzed' correctly expresses prior engineering analysis leading to subsequent calibration.
explanations.wrong_A: Base verb 'Analyze' cannot function as introductory participle.
explanations.wrong_B: Past form 'Analyzed' without auxiliary is passive, but specialists actively analyzed the curves.
explanations.wrong_D: 'Being analyzed' expresses continuous passive present, not prior completion.

questions.cz_learning_point: Předpřítomné participium (Having analyzed = poté, co analyzovali...) vyjadřuje děj, který předcházel hlavní větě.

questions.prompt: _____ active aerodynamic grille shutters reduce vehicle drag by 6%, cooling demands override aerodynamic efficiency under extreme track loads.

explanations.correct: 'Although' is a conjunction followed by a full clause with subject and verb ('active aerodynamic grille shutters reduce...').
explanations.wrong_A: 'In spite of' is a preposition and must be followed by a noun phrase or gerund.
explanations.wrong_C: 'Notwithstanding' is followed by a noun phrase.
explanations.wrong_D: 'Despite' is a preposition and cannot be followed directly by a finite clause.

questions.cz_learning_point: Spojka 'Although' (ačkoli) se pojí s celou větou s podmětem a slovesem, zatímco předložky jako 'Despite' a 'In spite of' vyžadují podstatné jméno.

questions.prompt: Direct gasoline fuel injection at 350 bar pressure is confirmed _____ fuel atomization and thermal efficiency across all RPM ranges.

explanations.correct: Perfect active infinitive 'to have improved' correctly attributes an established technological advance to high-pressure injection.
explanations.wrong_A: Present infinitive 'to improve' implies ongoing or future improvement rather than proven technological fact.
explanations.wrong_B: Participle 'improving' cannot follow passive reporting verb 'is confirmed'.
explanations.wrong_C: Passive 'to have been improved' incorrectly treats high-pressure injection as the object rather than the improving cause.

questions.cz_learning_point: Vazba 'is confirmed to have improved' (je potvrzeno, že zlepšilo) vyjadřuje minulý děj pomocí minulého infinitivu.

questions.prompt: Only after running smoke-stream visualization in the full-scale wind tunnel _____ the parasitic turbulent vortex behind the rear spoiler.

explanations.correct: Limiting introductory phrase 'Only after...' triggers subject-auxiliary inversion with Past Simple: 'did the aerodynamicists detect'.
explanations.wrong_B: 'the aerodynamicists detected' lacks required subject-auxiliary inversion.
explanations.wrong_C: 'detected the aerodynamicists' is archaic full inversion without auxiliary 'did'.
explanations.wrong_D: Present perfect conflicts with completed past wind-tunnel testing.

questions.cz_learning_point: Zdůrazňující úvodní vazba 'Only after...' vyžaduje inverzní slovosled: 'Only after running visualization did engineers detect...'.

questions.prompt: The electro-hydraulic mechatronic unit of the dual-clutch gearbox _____ overheated unless the transmission cooler was completely clogged.

explanations.correct: 'Cannot possibly have' expresses conclusive deduction of impossibility regarding a past mechanical event.
explanations.wrong_A: 'must not have' expresses negative deduction without impossibility nuance.
explanations.wrong_B: 'should not have' expresses unmet expectation or advice.

questions.cz_learning_point: Vyjádření naprosté nemožnosti v minulosti: 'cannot possibly have overheated' (rozhodně se nemohla přehřát, ledaže by chladič byl zcela ucpaný).

questions.prompt: Track-focused performance sports cars utilize a dry-sump lubrication system, by virtue of _____ centrifugal oil starvation is prevented in high-G turns.

explanations.correct: Formal prepositional relative phrase 'by virtue of which' strictly takes 'which' when modifying an engineering system.
explanations.wrong_A: 'that' cannot follow a preposition in formal relative clauses.

questions.cz_learning_point: Po formálních předložkových vazbách v rozvitých vztažných větách se používá výhradně 'which': 'by virtue of which' (na základě čehož / čímž).
